This strategy involves creating two identical environments, 'blue' and 'green', where one serves live traffic while the other is on standby. During updates, the new version of the chatbot will be deployed to the inactive environment, allowing for thorough testing and validation. Once confirmed, traffic will be switched to the updated environment, ensuring a smooth transition. This approach not only enhances operational efficiency but also mitigates risks associated with deployment failures. The project will include detailed planning, execution, and post-deployment monitoring to ensure optimal performance and user experience.
